about_the_game:
Welcome to the dark and vibrant world of Beast City, where the streets are boiling with clashes between bikers, police, gangsters, and hordes of zombies led by mad scientists. Every turn could be your last, and every card can change the course of battle.

Build your unique deck by mixing cards from different factions. Harness the strength and cunning of the police, the fury of bikers, the cunning of gangsters, and the destructive chaos of zombies. Upgrade your cards, unlock new abilities, and gradually take control of the city.
